units.source_text: 六条妃子回京之后，依旧住在六条的旧宫邸中。

en.t: After the Rokujo lady returned to the capital, she continued to live in the old Rokujo residence.

units.source_text: 屋宇大加修饰，崭然一新，生活十分悠闲风雅。

en.t: The buildings were extensively renovated and looked completely fresh, and her life there was leisurely and refined.

units.source_text: 她那温柔雅致之态依旧不变，邸内用了许多美貌侍女，自然变成了风流男子麇集之所。

en.t: Her gentle elegance remained unchanged, and with many beautiful serving women employed in the residence, it naturally became a gathering place for fashionable men.

units.source_text: 她自身虽然孤寂，但有种种趣事可以慰情。

en.t: Although she herself was lonely, there were many pleasant diversions to comfort her heart.

units.source_text: 岂料在这期间，忽然身患重病，心情异常忧惧。

en.t: Unexpectedly, during this time she suddenly fell seriously ill and became deeply anxious and afraid.

units.source_text: 她推想此乃近几年来因在伊势神宫不得勤修佛法，以至罪孽深重之故，

en.t: She thought this must be because, during the past several years at the Ise Shrine, she had been unable to practice the Buddhist teachings diligently and had therefore accumulated grave sins,

units.source_text: 悔恨之余，竟然落发做了尼姑。

en.t: and in the depth of her remorse, she finally cut off her hair and became a nun.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣闻此消息，心念我对此人情缘虽已断绝，

en.t: When Genji, the Inner Minister, heard this news, he thought that although his romantic bond with her had already been severed,

units.source_text: 但每逢兴会，她总是一个谈话良伴。

en.t: whenever refined occasions arose, she had always been a fine companion for conversation.

units.source_text: 如今她决然遁入空门，实甚可惜。

en.t: Now that she had resolutely entered the religious life, it was truly a great pity.

units.source_text: 吃惊之余，便赴六条宫邸拜访，殷勤慰问，情深无限。

en.t: Shocked by this, he went to the Rokujo residence to visit her, offering solicitous words of comfort with boundless feeling.
